description: Tsugaku Mimamori: a Japanese school-route check-in agent for children wearing glasses. Eight real school-route checkpoints (meeting place, crossing, park, railway crossing, convenience store, shrine, school gate, after-school meeting place) are checked in with a nod or Enter at each point, with the arrival time recorded. Going-to-school and coming-home records persist per day, and unreached points are reminded on the record page.
name: tsugaku-mimamori
